title: Yeonwoo

conquest.title: Petalbloom
conquest.description: Yeonwoo arcs Petalbloom outward in three waves, dealing Attack *100%, Attack *125%/137.5%/150%/162.5%/175%, and Attack *150%/165%/180%/195%/210% damage respectively, with the third being area of effect damage.

conquest.title: Falling Swallow
conquest.description: The Falling Swallow technique weaves confusion in enemy ranks, dealing Attack*100%/110%/120%/130%/140% damage and reducing target Attack Speed by 30%/35%/40%/45%/50%

conquest.title: Twin Fangs
conquest.description: Yeonwoo's unusual duel form is devilishly difficult to defend against, increasing Attack by 8%/12%/16%/20%/24%.

expedition.title: On Guard
expedition.description: "My blade and I are one". Yeonwoo's sword skills increases all Squads' total Lethality by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%.

expedition.title: Well-Traveled
expedition.description: Yeonwoo's travels have secured a technological edge, increasing Research Speed by 3%/6%/9%/12%/15%.

story: Yeonwoo is a passionate swordswoman, admired by all for her meticulous nature and sharp eye.
She has an uncanny ability to see things from a unique perspective, likely due to her extensive travels and broadened horizons.
Whether friend or foe, it is wise to always stay on high alert when you are around Yeonwoo.
"Accomplishing something is hard, but ruining it is easy." This is the principle Yeonwoo has lived by her whole life.
During her journeys, she saw many abandon their Convictions in pursuit of short-term gain. Most people understand the value of perseverance, but few truly practice it.
"A blade must be honed a thousand times to be sharp, and a dance takes a lifetime of dedication to master." Yeonwoo weaves this principle of swordsmanship into every aspect of her daily life.

Yeonwoo first held a sword at the age of five—a ceremonial blade that stood taller than she did. While other children were still busy playing and roughhousing, she rose early each morning, practicing her stance with quiet determination.

She tirelessly repeated the routine day after day, each session lasting for a few hours. It wasn't until a year later that her master, who was also her father, finally taught her the most basic moves.
At that moment, no one could have foreseen the remarkable things she would go on to achieve in the future.
Yeonwoo trains in autumn to absorb the spirit of fallen petals and races through stormy nights to emulate the grace of swallows. She incorporates everything she has seen and heard into her dance.
Each time she executes her moves, she reconnects with her beliefs and purpose. Each time she sheaths her sword, she quiets her restlessness with calm.
Yeonwoo believes that the vast insights gained from her travels, intertwined with her skills, will one day give rise to the ultimate dance—one that embodies the heart and soul of the world.
